alienbrain.name: Alien Brain
alienbrain.desc: When a Reptile-Type monster you control is destroyed by battle with an opponent's attacking monster and sent to the Graveyard: Take control of the opponent's monster, and if you do, it becomes Reptile-Type.

anteatereatingant.name: Anteatereatingant
anteatereatingant.desc: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card cannot be Special Summoned except by sending 2 Spell or Trap Cards you control to the Graveyard. You can destroy 1 Spell or Trap Card your opponent controls. If you activate this effect, this card cannot attack during this turn.

battletuned.name: Battle Tuned
battletuned.desc: Remove from play 1 Tuner monster from your Graveyard. Target face-up monster you control gains ATK equal to the removed monster's ATK.

battlewasprapiertheonslaught.name: Battlewasp - Rapier the Onslaught
battlewasprapiertheonslaught.desc: If you control no face-up monsters, or the only face-up monsters you control are Insect monsters: You can discard 1 other Insect monster; place 1 "Battlewasp Wind" from your Deck, face-up in your Spell & Trap Zone, then Special Summon this card from your hand, also you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck for the rest of this turn, except Insect monsters. You can banish this card from your GY; reduce the Level of 1 Insect monster you control by 1. You can only use each effect of "Battlewasp - Rapier the Onslaught" once per turn.

blastmagician.name: Blast Magician
blastmagician.desc: Each time a Spell Card is activated, place 1 Spell Counter on this card when that Spell Card resolves. You can remove any number of Spell Counters from this card, then target 1 face-up monster on the field with ATK less than or equal to the number of counters you removed x 700; destroy that target.

chaosarchfiend.name: Chaos Archfiend
chaosarchfiend.desc:
1 LIGHT Tuner + 1+ non-Tuner DARK monsters
If any card(s) have been banished this turn, this card gains 2000 ATK. This card can attack all monsters your opponent controls, once each, also banish any monster destroyed by battle with this card. If this card in its owner's control leaves the field because of an opponent's card: You can Special Summon 1 "Chaos" Synchro Monster from your Extra Deck, except "Chaos Archfiend". You can only use this effect of "Chaos Archfiend" once per turn.

chronomalymoai.name: Chronomaly Moai
chronomalymoai.desc: If you control a face-up "Chronomaly" monster, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand) in face-up Defense Position.

drainingshield.name: Draining Shield
drainingshield.desc: When an opponent's monster declares an attack: Target the attacking monster; negate that attack, and if you do, gain LP equal to that target's ATK.

elfnotetinia.name: Elfnote Tinia
elfnotetinia.desc: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand) to your center Main Monster Zone. You can only Special Summon "Elfnote Tinia" once per turn this way. You can only use each of the following effects of "Elfnote Tinia" once per turn. During your Main Phase: You can place 1 "Elfnote" Continuous Spell from your Deck face-up on your field. During your opponent's turn (Quick Effect): You can switch the locations of this card in your Main Monster Zone and the monster in your center Main Monster Zone, then you can banish (face-up) 1 random card from your opponent's hand, until the End Phase.

enlightenment.name: Enlightenment
enlightenment.desc: You cannot Summon the turn you activate this card. Activate at the end of the Damage Step, if a Spellcaster-Type monster you control attacked and destroyed an opponent's monster by battle. That monster can attack again (immediately).

evolsaurdiplo.name: Evolsaur Diplo
evolsaurdiplo.desc: When this card is Special Summoned by the effect of an "Evoltile" monster: Target 1 Spell/Trap Card your opponent controls; destroy that target.

fairycheergirl.name: Fairy Cheer Girl
fairycheergirl.desc:
2 Level 4 Fairy-Type monsters
You can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card; draw 1 card. You can only use this effect of "Fairy Cheer Girl" once per turn.

gemknightobsidian.name: Gem-Knight Obsidian
gemknightobsidian.desc: If this card is sent from the hand to your Graveyard: You can target 1 Level 4 or lower Normal Monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon that target.

inferno.name: Inferno
inferno.desc: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) by banishing 1 FIRE monster from your GY. If this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle and sends it to the GY: Inflict 1500 damage to your opponent.

kingsconsonance.name: King's Consonance
kingsconsonance.desc: When an opponent's monster declares a direct attack: Negate the attack, then you can apply the rest of this card's effect. Banish 1 Tuner monster and any number of non-Tuner monsters from your Graveyard, whose total Levels equal 8 or less, and if you do, Special Summon from your Extra Deck 1 Synchro Monster whose Level equals the total Levels of those banished monsters. (This Special Summon is treated as a Synchro Summon.)

liberatoreto.name: Liberator Eto
liberatoreto.desc: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand or GY) by paying half your LP, while your opponent has a Monster Card in their field or GY with an effect that activates in the hand or Monster Zone in response to a card or effect activation. You can only Special Summon "Liberator Eto" once per turn this way. This card's Special Summon cannot be negated. This face-up card cannot be used as material for a Fusion, Synchro, Xyz, or Link Summon, also during your turn only, it is unaffected by monster effects activated on your opponent's field.

miraclejurassicegg.name: Miracle Jurassic Egg
miraclejurassicegg.desc: While face-up on the field, this card cannot be banished. Each time a Dinosaur-Type monster(s) is sent to your Graveyard, place 2 counters on this card. You can Tribute this card; Special Summon 1 Dinosaur-Type monster from your Deck whose Level is less than or equal to the number of counters that were on this card.

performapalsecondonkey.name: Performapal Secondonkey
performapalsecondonkey.desc: When this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can send 1 "Performapal" monster from your Deck to the Graveyard, except "Performapal Secondonkey". If you have 2 cards in your Pendulum Zones, you can add it to your hand instead.

princessdracaenathethirstingtree.name: Princess Dracaena, the Thirsting Tree
princessdracaenathethirstingtree.desc: You can send 1 Level 4 or lower Plant monster from your Deck to the GY, except "Princess Dracaena, the Thirsting Tree"; Special Summon this card from your hand, and if you do, it becomes that sent monster's Level. You can banish 1 Plant monster and this card from your GY; Special Summon 1 Dragon monster from your hand or GY. You can only use each effect of "Princess Dracaena, the Thirsting Tree" once per turn, also you cannot Special Summon the turn you activate either of this card's effects, except Dragon or Plant monsters.

queenazamina.name: Queen Azamina
queenazamina.desc:
(This card is always treated as a "Sinful Spoils" card.)
If this card in your hand or field is sent to the GY or banished, by an activated effect: You can Special Summon it. When your "Azamina" or "White Forest" monster destroys an opponent's monster by battle: You can target 1 "Sinful Spoils" Spell/Trap in your GY; add it to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Queen Azamina" once per turn.

shinyblackcsquadder.name: Shiny Black "C" Squadder
shinyblackcsquadder.desc: ''Wherever there are shadows, you'll find the "C" Squad! Their hidden flying abilities let them confront the giants on equal terms!''

sinisterserpent.name: Sinister Serpent
sinisterserpent.desc: During your Standby Phase, if this card is in your GY: You can add it to your hand, also banish 1 "Sinister Serpent" from your GY during your opponent's next End Phase. You can only use this effect of "Sinister Serpent" once per turn.

spiralspearstrike.name: Spiral Spear Strike
spiralspearstrike.desc: If "Gaia The Fierce Knight", "Swift Gaia the Fierce Knight", or "Gaia the Dragon Champion" you control attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent. If "Gaia the Dragon Champion" inflicts battle damage with this effect: Draw 2 cards, then discard 1 card.

thefabledganashia.name: The Fabled Ganashia
thefabledganashia.desc: If this card is discarded to the GY: Special Summon it. If Summoned this way, it gains 200 ATK, but banish it when it leaves the field.

thegreatnoodleinversion.name: The Great Noodle Inversion
thegreatnoodleinversion.desc: Add the bottom card of your Deck to your hand, then take 1 card from your Deck, shuffle, and place that card on the bottom of the Deck.

topologicblasterdragon.name: Topologic Blaster Dragon
topologicblasterdragon.desc:
2+ Effect Monsters
You cannot Summon/Set monsters to any Extra Monster Zone this card points to. If another monster is Special Summoned to a zone a Link Monster points to, while this card is in the Extra Monster Zone: Apply 1 of these effects (but you cannot apply that same effect of "Topologic Blaster Dragon" again this turn).
● Shuffle all other monsters on the field into the Deck.
● Shuffle all Spells/Traps on the field into the Deck.
● Look at your opponent's Extra Deck and banish 1 card from it.

vylonsegment.name: Vylon Segment
vylonsegment.desc: Equip only to a "Vylon" monster. It cannot be targeted by the opponent's monster effects or Trap effects. If this face-up card on the field is sent to the Graveyard: You can add 1 "Vylon" Spell Card from your Deck to your hand.

yormungarde.name: Yormungarde
yormungarde.desc: ''An extremely long snake that dwells in the world of myth.''
